description: Use when an agent needs the weather anywhere in the world. Input: lat and lon, or city (Paris or Paris,FR), optional hours (0-72, default 24), tz (IANA zone, default UTC or the city's). Output: JSON current temperature, symbol, wind, humidity, cloud, pressure; hourly series; daily min/max, precipitation, max wind, symbol for ~10 days. Data: MET Norway. Example: ?city=London,GB or ?lat=51.5072&lon=-0.1276 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

city.description: City name instead of lat/lon, optional ,CC country code (most populous match; unknown city → 400 before payment)

lat.description: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees (rounded to 0.01); with lon, or use city

lon.description: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees (rounded to 0.01); with lat, or use city

tz.description: IANA time zone for daily summaries and local hours (default UTC)

name: weather_global
title: Worldwide weather forecast: current, hourly (72 h) and 10-day daily for any coordinates
